requirement: The estimator shall expose the interface X = kalman_update(Z
The estimator shall return an N-by-4 matrix of posterior estimates, one row per input measurement, in input order.
The estimator shall implement the predict/update recursion of §4 using the model constants, including initializing state and covariance from model.x0 and model.P0.
The estimator shall be deterministic: identical (Z, model) yields identical X.
The implementation shall be accompanied by a runnable test on test_vectors.csv exercising R1-R4.
Non-finite (NaN/Inf) or malformed measurements shall be rejected and reported to the caller, never propagated into the state estimate.
